visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People]: A female doctor with short brown hair and glasses talks directly to the camera, gesturing with her head. [Objects]: She wears a beige blouse and a gold ring. [Setting]: A bright, professional clinic office with soft lighting, blinds on the window, and framed certificates on the wall. [Text]: A logo for DRX Dermatology and a question about acne scars appear at the top and bottom. (2) [People]: A patient lies down with eyes protected by metal shields; a doctor's gloved hand operates a medical device. [Objects]: A cotton swab and a laser tip are applied to red, inflamed facial skin showing active treatment marks. [Setting]: A clinical procedure room with high-intensity medical lighting and surgical equipment. [Text]: Explanatory subtitles continue at the bottom. (3) [People]: Back to the female doctor who uses a pinching hand gesture with her fingers to emphasize small increments of change. [Objects]: Wearing a beige blouse and a gold ring. [Setting]: The same professional office environment with soft indoor lighting. [Text]: Variety captions emphasize her points about permanent skin damage. (4) [People]: No people visible, focus is on skin details. [Objects]: Medical photography showing split-screen comparisons of dark and red pigmentation on cheeks, followed by a close-up of deep pitted acne scars. [Setting]: Flat background for medical illustration. [Text]: Category labels for different types of scars appear on screen. (5) [People]: No people. [Objects]: A gray and white final graphic screen. [Setting]: Minimalist graphic background. [Text]: Full contact information including LINE ID, phone number, and branch addresses in Taipei and New Taipei City.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 痘疤一定要靠醫美療程嗎? (2) [Variety]: 一定要! [Subtitle]: 我這裡不是詐騙集團... (3) [Subtitle]: 絕對沒有說擦什麼東西，你的痘疤就會撫平。 (4) [Subtitle]: 縱使做了很痛很痛的雷射，每一次就是一點一點一點。 (5) [Subtitle]: 因為痘疤它就是一個永久的東西。 (6) [Subtitle]: 裡面所有皮膚真皮層的結構完全都改變了。 (7) [Subtitle]: 你如果沒有打雷射，只靠擦保養品甚至擦A酸，都深不到疤痕所在的位置。 (8) [Subtitle]: 所以這個就是為什麼用擦的痘疤是完全沒辦法改變。 (9) [Subtitle]: 如果說你今天黑色素痘疤或是紅色素痘疤。 (10) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所. [Variety]: 黑痘疤, 紅痘疤. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個是可以靠時間可以慢慢淡化的。 (12) [Subtitle]: 痘疤如果已經凹陷下去了，手術、雷射啊，這些大的治療都是必須要做的。 (13) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: @drx.derm, 02-8985-9060, 新北市三重區正義北路104號2F, 台北市中山區南京東路一段96號, 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
